Our Story

Clean homes, gentle on nature

Conariyaco was created around one simple idea: cleaning shouldn’t cost you your comfort or the planet. Too many everyday cleaners rely on harsh formulas that are tough on hands, surfaces and the environment. We wanted to change that.

That’s why every Conariyaco product is plant-based, eco friendly and non toxic. From tap and kitchen cleaners to floor, glass, copper and jewellery care, each one is made to tackle real stains and leave your home fresh, safe and shining.

And this is only the beginning. Shampoo, hair oil, soap and body wash are on their way, bringing the same plant-based care from your home to you.

Cleaner homes. Greener tomorrow.
